title: Add public provenance attestation for agent-produced artifacts
summary: Define and implement a verifiable provenance path that connects local agent actions, signed commits or release artifacts, CI runs, and eventually a public transparency log.
expectedFailureModes: Local signatures prove possession of a key but do not prove which automation or workflow produced the artifact.
Attestation metadata leaks machine-local paths, private usernames, or operational details.
A public verification story depends on a private key registry that outside contributors cannot audit.
humanEscalation: Selection of public signing identity policy
Approval before publishing transparency-log or release-signing claims
nextAction: Draft an architecture decision for signed task records and release provenance before changing signing code.
